metadata.title: Biologics Price Competition and Innovation Act of 2009 (Title VII, Subtitle A of Pub. L. 111-148)
metadata.legal_basis: United States Code (2024 edition); binding statute. The official text governs; check for later amendments.
metadata.applicability: Created PHS Act 351(k): biosimilars and interchangeables carry 600.80 postmarketing safety obligations, and switching and traceability bear on PV.
